assumptions.statement: The submitted site boundary is the repository-maintained provisional polygon, not an official redline.
assumptions.impact: It supports package generation, topology checks and conceptual discussion only; all geometry, metrics and figures must be regenerated when official geometry is released.

assumptions.statement: The three key-area polygons are provisional rough rectangles; PROV-KEY-003 is not reliably anchored to Dazhongsi Station.
assumptions.impact: Key-area names express programme roles, not precise station, parcel or building locations. The source geometry is preserved for repository consistency.

assumptions.statement: Official regulatory controls, road redlines, parcels, ownership, utilities, fire, flood and facility baselines are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: FAR, height, density, green-space control, setbacks, road engineering and municipal capacities remain unknown.

assumptions.statement: No cleared existing-building survey or condition dataset is available.
assumptions.impact: The nine submitted footprints are reversible interface prototypes only and cannot support retain-renovate-demolish decisions or total floor-area claims.

assumptions.statement: No real scene owner, operator, budget, staffing plan, field authorization or measured performance currently exists for the proposed pilots.
assumptions.impact: Phases and operating indicators are proposals; field performance remains unknown until authorized pilots establish baselines.

assumptions.statement: The CALL state machine translates Han Jin's lead-intake, follow-up and repeat-use methods into a public-interest process.
assumptions.impact: Residents are not customers and civic problems are not commercial leads; growth means better response, closure and reuse, not more personal data or exposure.

assumptions.statement: All scenarios are designed around data minimization, non-digital alternatives and human decision gates, but no project-specific data impact assessment has been authorized.
assumptions.impact: No real personal data, automated high-risk decision, diagnosis, procurement or case closure is permitted within the proposal stage.

assumptions.statement: Exact heritage protection, park implementation and construction-control lines are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Landmarks and public interfaces remain movable, low-volume or existing-space adaptations pending heritage and park review.

assumptions.statement: Submission text and graphics are original; public facts and case mechanisms are attributed. Any future OSM context layer must retain ODbL attribution.
assumptions.impact: Third-party marks, portraits, remote imagery and uncleared datasets are excluded from shipped visual artifacts.

assumptions.statement: Neither the Agent nor the operator conducted a site visit, authorised interview or resident survey for this submission; personas and need priorities are inferred research lenses only.
assumptions.impact: No field condition, stakeholder consensus, demand ranking or lived-experience claim is validated. Each pilot requires authorised site verification and participation by affected groups and accountable professionals.

assumptions.statement: Public Issue #1061 questions Agent substitution, abstract language, absent field experience and social legitimacy; this proposal partially adopts its implementation-contract and evidence-disclosure recommendations.
assumptions.impact: The issue remains an open objection rather than consent or closure. Any real-world use requires organiser-led consent, privacy safeguards, a comment-response ledger, professional review and statutory process.

assumptions.statement: Without authorised public participation, informed consent and a recorded comment-response status, the package must not claim resident support, public recognition, consensus reached or equivalent public-authorisation conclusions.
assumptions.impact: Public Issues, personas, scene orders and local package checks can identify risks and questions, but cannot be upgraded into resident consent, demand ranking, planning approval or implementation authority.
